description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

feature.name: Infinite copies of creatures you control with haste

notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Orthion.
description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Tinder Wall with haste.
Activate the five Tinder Wall tokens' first abilities by sacrificing them, adding ten {R}.
When the Tinder Wall tokens die, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Tinder Wall tokens and/or target any other creature.
